title: Cebu City needs ordinance, funding support for medium-rise buildings

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Cebu City needs an enabling ordinance or supplemental appropriation to fully support the executive order creating a committee to manage city-owned medium-rise buildings (MRBs), according to an opinion from the City Attorney’s Office. The legal opinion, dated September 17, 2026, concerns Executive Order No. 094, Series of 2026, issued by Mayor Nestor Archival on August 12 to establish the Medium Rise Building Executive Committee and define its composition, powers and functions in administering, managing and operating city-owned MRBs.
